Existing 18.08×95×65.35 mm asset envelope and all conductor endpoints retained. Nominal 18×90×64 mm body, 95 mm overall mounting tabs. Stepped body and open DIN notch. Dimensioned visualization, not manufacturer STEP or certified metrology.
